name: skip-link
title: Skip Link
description: A link at the very start of the page, hidden until it has keyboard focus, that jumps past the header and navigation to the main content (WCAG 2.4.1).

meta.when: Every page with a header or navigation before its content: put it first inside `<body>`, and give the main content the id it points to. Several can go in a row (to the content, to the search).
